dedupe_keys.name: model files for effectiveness of stormwater control measures in protecting stream channel stability

description: Model Files for "Effectiveness of Stormwater Control Measures in Protecting Stream Channel Stability" is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Towsif Khan, Sami (deposited on HydroShare). This resource archives Model files supporting the paper "Effectiveness of Stormwater Control Measures in Protecting Stream Channel Stability". The abstract for this paper follows: "While research on the hydrologic impact of different types of stormwater control measures (SCMs) is extensive, little research exists linking urbanization, widespread implementation of SCMs, and channel stability in headwater streams. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2024-03-09 and last updated 2024-03-11; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
